content:
[Intro]
[C#5]

[Verse 1]
[C#5]I broke you in
the canyon
I drowned you in
the lake
You a snake that I
would trample
Only thing I'd not
embrace

[Chorus]
[C#5]Oh, you couldn't dam
that river
And maybe I don't give a damn
anyway
So you couldn't dam
that river
And it washed me so
far away

[Verse 2]
[C#5]I pushed and then
you stumbled
I kicked you in
the face
You stare at me
so hollow
Got to keep that kil-
lin' pace

[Chorus]
[C#5]Oh, you couldn't dam
that river
And maybe I don't give a damn
anyway
So you couldn't dam
that river
And it washed me so
far away

[Solo]
[E5]
[C#5]
[E5]
[C#5]
[E5]
[C#5]
[E5]

[Verse 3]
[C#5]I burned the place
around you
I hit you with
a rake
You piss upon
my candle
So proving you're
a fake

[Outro]
[C#5]Oh, you couldn't dam
that river
And maybe I don't give a damn
anyway
So you couldn't dam
that river
And it washed me so
far away
title: Dam That River
tuning: C# G# C# F# A# D#
